messages:
sahil: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: consolidating owners + short mitigations for the vendor/auth/registry outage. Please ack + ETA.

maria: Ack. I'll run registry geo-replication design. Doc by Tue, PoC in the next sprint.

alex: Taking auth resilience (cached JWKS + token-bridge signed by our KMS). PoC by Fri EOD, tests next week.

anne: I'll drive vendor SLA / escalation language; requesting AE. Draft legal + AE request by Wed.

julie: Ops wants automatic fallback to local quantized model for public routes with circuit-breaker. I'll prepare packaging checklist and QA tests.

ops-oncall: I'll add cross-region synthetic healthchecks and Grafana panels. Staging by next Tue, prod after 48h stable. Scheduling a DR drill to exercise these flows; RSVP please.

devops-bot: Created tickets: INF-3601 registry-replication (assignee: maria), INF-3602 auth-fallback (assignee: alex), INF-3603 vendor-runbook (assignee: anne), INF-3604 cross-region-synthetics (assignee: ops-oncall). Links: https://jira.redwoodinfra/INF-3602

sahil: Summary: maria (INF-3601), alex (INF-3602), anne (INF-3603), ops-oncall (INF-3604), julie (fallback packaging). Weekly Jira updates; flag blockers here before infra sync.

maria: Noted. Design will include read-only secondary + checksum backfill plan.

alex: Security note: fallback tokens will include fallback_reason claim and short TTL. Will post code sketch in PR.

julie: Adding metric request: auth_fallback_rate and fallback_success_ratio to alerting playbook.

ops-oncall: Added metrics to INF-3604 checklist. RSVP'd for DR drill; will run auth-down and registry-read-error scenarios.

sahil: Thanks all. I'll post short daily check-ins until PoCs land. Reopen thread for vendor/legal blockers.
